agent-commit-validation gate on feature/agent-collab-updates (PR #498) is a GENUINE violation ...

answer:
`validate-agent-commit.sh` blocks change sets whose only content is edits to test files that exist on the base branch (at the merge-base), with no new test methods introduced. It exits with code `2` when such a violation is detected.

Per `tools/ci/README.md:112`, its purpose is `agent-commit-validation: reject a change set whose only content is edits to test files that exist on the base branch (at the merge-base), with no new test in them`. Per `flowtree/runtime/docs/file-staging.md:378`, it uses `test-method-lines.awk` to distinguish new vs. edited test methods.

Example invocation and exit code:  
```bash
bash tools/ci/agent-protection/validate-agent-commit.sh origin/master
# exits 2 if blocking condition is met
```  
as confirmed in Note 2 (`tools/ci/agent-protection/validate-agent-commit.sh origin/master` exits 2).
